name: Create small test file in actor OneDrive
description: test-user-01 creates a small text file in their own OneDrive root. The file name carries the scenario-correlation token. The file content is a deterministic marker for operator review.
correlation_strategy: File name carries the scenario-correlation token.
notes: Files.ReadWrite is required. The scenario only writes to the actor's own OneDrive; Sites.ReadWrite.All is not required and not requested.
